tasks.label: FS Lua: Fix Linux LuaLS
tasks.detail: Download the Linux LuaLS build and symlink it over the Windows-only .exe bundled with the Farming Simulator IDE extension. Idempotent - safe to re-run after extension updates. After it succeeds, run 'FS Lua: Restart Language Server' from the command palette.

tasks.label: Link Mod (dev symlink)
tasks.detail: Symlink modfiles/ into the game's mods folder for live singleplayer development. Idempotent - safe to re-run.

tasks.label: Remove Mod Link (for MP)
tasks.detail: Remove the FS25_AdjustableMirrors dev symlink so the deployed .zip takes precedence. Run before playing online servers that require the mod.

tasks.label: Deploy Mod (zip for MP)
tasks.detail: Zip modfiles/ into FS25_AdjustableMirrors.zip and copy it to the game's mods folder. Required for multiplayer (only zip mods are supported in MP).
